note: Real-world size (largest dimension, metres) and effective density (kg/m3) per prop. Generated meshes arrive normalized to ~2 units; Unity scales each prop to size_m before building its joints, and each part's mass is density x its enclosed mesh volume. Generated meshes are solid where the real object is hollow, so densities are effective values (material density x how full the object really is). anchored: the prop is a fixture (a vault door is set in a wall), so its body stays put on the demo stage; every other prop stands free.
